report:
Antecedentes Clínicos:
Gonalgia derecha.
Hallazgos:
Formación quística subcortical del aspecto anterior del platillo tibial medial de 7 x 6 mm en sus
ejes mayores, sin significado patológico específico.
No hay otras alteraciones de señal de la médula ósea.
Ligamentos cruzados y colaterales dentro de límites normales.
Meniscos impresionan de morfología y señal conservada, sin signos de rotura.
Condropatía superficial de la zona de carga de los compartimentos femorotibiales. Cartílago
troclear sin alteraciones. Úlceras condrales de espesor parcial del cartílago rotuliano su faceta
lateral sin cambios óseos secundarios.
Mínimo derrame articular. No hay quistes poplíteos patológicos.
Edema del paquete adiposo retro cuadricipital suprarrotuliano.
Tendones cuadricipital, la pata de ganso, bíceps femoral y banda iliotibial dentro de límites
normales.
Aumento de señal de la inserción proximal del tendón rotuliano, sin signos de rotura.
Impresión:
Condropatía superficial de la zona de carga de los compartimentos femorotibiales.
Condropatía lesiones grado 2 de la rótula.
Mínimo derrame articular.
Edema del paquete adiposo retro cuadricipital suprarrotuliano, hallazgo inespecífico, podría
representar fenómenos de mal alineamiento rotuliano.
Leve tendinosis rotuliana proximal.

Regelrechte Artikulationsverhältnisse femorotibial und femoropatellar. Homogener Knorpelbesatz, kein tiefergreifende Chondropathie-Areal. Altersentsprechend regelrechtes Knochenmarksignal, kein Bone Bruise / Knochenmarködem. Floride Veränderungen des Innenmeniskushinterhorns. Riss des Außenmeniskus mit V.a. in die Notch umgeschlagenen Anteilen. Kreuz- und Kollateralbänder intakt. Keine größere Baker-Zyste. Kein relevanter Kniegelenkserguss.

Exam Type: MRI KNEE LEFT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Pain.
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the left knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Bone marrow signal is normal. No acute fracture or bone bruise. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
Small joint effusion. A lobulated ganglion cyst arises from the anterior joint capsule, and extends into Hoffa's fat pad. No Baker cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: There is a complex tear involving the posterior horn extending to the body, with moderate extrusion.
Medial compartment cartilage: Mild cartilage thinning is present at the weightbearing aspect diffusely. Small osteophytes.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: There is a complex tear at the posterior root attachment, with mild extrusion.
Lateral compartment cartilage: Mild cartilage thinning and fissuring is present at the central and posterior aspect. Small osteophytes.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: There is mild to moderate cartilage thinning and fissuring at the patella diffusely. Trochlear cartilage appears intact. Small osteophytes.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): There is mucoid degeneration of the anterior cruciate ligament, with evidence of chronic partial tear.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. Patella alta is present. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 14 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:

1. Medial and lateral meniscal tear.
2. Tricompartmental chondrosis.
3. Mucoid degeneration of the anterior cruciate ligament with evidence of chronic partial tear.
4. Ganglion cyst within Hoffa's fat pad.

Nahezu vollständig regredientes Bone bruise der medialen Femurkondyle bei nachweisbarer subchondraler Insuffizienzfraktur in der Voruntersuchung [DATE]. Regelrechte Artikulation im Kniegelenk. Bekannte fortgeschrittene Chondropathie der Trochlea sowie des lateralen Kompartimentes mit teils flächig tief greifenden Anteilen (4/22). Reduzierter Knorpelbesatz auch im medialen Kompartiment ohne fokale Chondropathie. Kreuzbänder intakt. Konstant zur Voruntersuchung multiple Zysten dorsal des HKB-Ansatzes auf Höhe des Tibiaplateaus, DD degenerativ. Konstante Signalanhebung des Innenmeniskushinterhorns bei mukoider Degeneration. Keine meniskale Rissbildung. Kollateralbänder intakt. Kein Gelenkserguss. Fabella.

Potupuni gubitak hrskavice u prednjoj i srednjoj trećini medijalnog platoa tibije i femoralnog
kondila uz edem prilježeće subhondralne kosti te po jedna subhondralna cista - hondomalacija
IV°. U stražnjoj trećini hrskavica stanjena.
Politopne erozije zglobnih hrskavica, mjestimice s subhondralnim cistama u sklopu
uznapredovalih deg. promjena.
Osteofiti zglobnih površina patele, trohleje femura, oba tibijalna platoa i femoralna kondila (s
ventralne i dorzalne strane).
Suženje zglobnog prostora femorotibijalnog i patelofemoralnog zgloba.
Izljev u koljenu.
Prednji križni ligament izmjenjenog intenziteta signala u smislu uznapredovale mukoidne
degeneracije, prati se u kontinuitetu.
Stražnji križni ligament izmjenjenog intenziteta signala u smislu blažih degenerativnih promjena,
bez znakova rupture.
Medijalni menisk je izmjenjenoig intenziteta signala u smislu mikosidne degeneracije sa
kompleksnom rupturom trupa i značajnom ektruzijom pod MCL koja mjeri za oko 9mm te
kaudalnom i kranijalnom migracijom za oko 8mm .
Lateralni menisk je izmjenjenog intenziteta signala u smislu miksoidne degeneracije uz vidlju
kompleksnu rupturu prednjeg roga i anteriornog dijela korpusa. Parameniscealna cista uz prednji
rog 8 mm.
Lateralni i medijalni kolateralni ligamenti urednog signala te se prate u kontinuitetu.
Tetiva m. popliteusa je izmjenjenog intenziteta signala pri proksimalnoj inserciji u smislu
tendinoze.
Entezopatske promjene hvatišta tetive kvadricepsa i patelanog ligamenta na pateli.
Poplitealna cista, veličine AP 3cm.

MRI of Left Knee with 
-3-Plane Loc, Sag PD FS, Sag T2 FS, Sag T1, Cor T2 FS, Ax T2 FS, Screen Save

*  Increased signal intensity in ACL on F/S T2WI, R/O grade 1 injury.
*  Linear signal intensity in posterior horn of medial meniscus, with extending into the surface and meniscal root and protrusion of medial meniscus, in favor of tear.
   There are linear signal intensity in lateral meniscus, without significant extends into the surface , R/O grade 2 intrasubstance signal.
* Fluid accmulation around medial head of gastrocnemius muscle and synovial bursa, r/o gastrocnemius bursitis.
* Fluid accumulation in the posterior articular capsule to retrocruciate ligament recess.
* Increased fat stranding and minimal fluid accumulation located along the pes anserinus, reflecting Anserine bursitis
* Increased signal intensity in F/S T2WI at tibial medial condyle, bone marrow edema is considered.
* A lobulated cystic lesion in popliteal fossa with a small recess of the knee joint capsule lies medially between the tendons of the medial head of the gastrocnemius and the semimembranosus muscles, in favor of small Baker's cyst.
* Joint effusion and suprapatellar bursitis with suprapatellar, lateral and medial plicae; hypertrophy of the synovium, indicative of synovitis.
* Subchondral cysts noted in the intercondylar eminence of proximal tibia and spur formation, in favor of degeneration.
> No significant myositis noted at distal thights to proximal legs.
> The contour of PCL appear to be within normal, no abnormal signal intensity is noted.
> Wearing of articular cartilage of medial compartment and spur formation and mild subchondral bone marrow edema over medial tibial plateau, reflecting osteoarthritis.
Impression:
1. Tear of posterior horn of medial meniscus; R/O grade 2 intrasubstance signal in lateral meniscus.
2. Osteoarthritis of left knee ( more severe at medial compartment) with synovitis and small Baker's cyst
3. Anserine bursitis
4. Grade 1 injury of ACL.
Suggest correlation with clinical manifestation.

МР находка: Няма  данни за ставен излив. Костите формиращи коленните стави са с нормална форма. Тип 2 патели. В пателата на дясната колянна става се вижда слабо изразен костномозъчен едем. Изобразява се малка лезия на хрущяла на дясната патела, по нейната медиална ставна повърхност. Ставните хрущяли на фемурите, тибиите и на лявата патела са интактни. МР данни за начални дегенеративни промени в задния рог на медиалния менискус на лявата колянна става. Задният рог на този менискус е със слабо повишен интензитет на сигнала, без да се дефинира скъсване. Нормално изобразяване на кръстните връзки. Ретинакулуми на пателите – без особености. Колатерални лигаменти – без особености. Лигамент на пателите, сухожилия на мм. квадрицепс феморис – без особености.  Поплитеални ямки – б.о.  Изобразени мускулни групи – б.о. Заключение: МР данни за хондромалация на дясната патела –  grade 4. Не се намират други изменения в дясната колянна става.  Начални дегенеративни промени в задния рог на медиалния менискус на лявата колянна става, без видимо скъсване.

Mediales Kompartiment:
Zur letzten MRT-Voruntersuchung vom [DATE] konstant Nachweis einer osteochondralen Läsion an der posteromedialen Femurcondyle nahe dem Sulcus intercondylaris über eine Ausdehnung von 6 x 8 x cc 3 mm mit größenprogredienten subchondralen Zysten (Serie 4/ Image 19). Ansonsten refegrelchtes Knochenmarksignal und intakter Knorpel. Intakter Innenmeniskus. Intaktes MCL.

Laterales Kompartiment:
Regelrechtes Knochenmarksignal. Intakter Knorpel. Intakter Außenmeniskus. Intakes LCL.

Femoropatellares Gleitlager und Trochlea:
Regelrechtes Knochenmarksignal. Fokaler, oberflächlicher Knorpeldefekt retropatellar an der medialen Patellafacette (Serie 7/ Image 10). Kein tiefgreifender oder vollschichtiger Knorpeldefekt. Kein subchondrales Knochenödem. Regelrechte Darstellung der Quadrizeps- und Patellarsehne. Regelrechte Darstellung des Hoffa`schen Fettkörpers.

Kreuzbänder:
Intakte Kreubänder.

Muskulatur und übrige Weichteile:
Akzentuierte Gelenkflüssigkeit.

MRI of Knee with 
-SG PD FatSat, Locator, SG T2W FS, CO T2W FS, SG T1W, AX T2W FS

> A lobulated cystic lesion in medial popliteal fossa between the tendons and muscle of the medial head of the gastrocnemius and the semimembranosus muscles, in favor of Baker's cyst, about 5 cm in size.
> The contour of PCL not all in a straight line and increase signal intensity inside, in favor of partial tear.
> Linear signal intensity in posterior horn of medial meniscus and increased signal intensity of meniscocapsular junction, in favor of degeneration
> Increased singal intensity of patellar cartilage with deep fissures, in favor of grade III patellar chondromalacia.
  Mild wearing of articular carilatge of right knee with small osteophyte.
> Joint effusion and suprapatellar bursitis with suprapatellar and medial plicae; hypertrophy of the synovium, indicative of synovitis.
> Loculated cystic lesion in medial popliteal fossa between the tendons of the medial head of the gastrocnemius and the semimembranosus muscles, in favor of Baker's cyst.
> Increased fat stranding and minimal fluid accumulation located along the pes anserinus and MCL, in favor of Anserine bursitis.

Impression: 
1. Cystic mass in medial popliteal fossa, in favor of Baker's cyst.
2. Mild Anserine bursitis.
3. Partial tear of PCL.
3. Degeneration of posterior horn of medial meniscus.
4. Osteoarthritis of right knee; grade 3 patellar chondromalacia.
5. Mild synovitis of right knee.
Suggest correlation of clinical manifestation and lab data

Diz eklemindeki trikompartmantal dejeneratif eklem hastalığı medyal femoral tibyal kompartmanda en belirgin ve tam kata ulaşan eklem kıkırdağı kaybı ve dejenerasyonu, subkondral medüller fibrokistik ve fibrovasküler değişiklikler ve marjinal osteofitlerle karakterize. Diz eklemi içi sıvı miktarı orta derecede artmış. Ön çapraz bağdaki mukoid dejenerasyon dışında çapraz bağlar normal. İç yan bağın derin bileşeni ödemli Medyale 6 mm ekstrude medyal menisküsün arka boynuzundaki kompleks dejeneratif yırtık süperiyor ve inferiyor eklem yüzeylerine ulaşıyor. Lateral menisküstaki yapı içi dejenerasyon eklem yüzeylerine yırtk biçiminde ulaşmıyor. Patellar tendonozis.
